findings.highlight: It doesn’t matter what my body’s made of.
findings.evidenceJa: 体が何に変貌していようと同じこと。
findings.governingReading: It makes no difference what his body has transformed into.
findings.explanation: The English changes bodily transformation into material composition.

findings.highlight: the impact mercilessly pierces through me.
findings.evidenceJa: 容赦なく衝撃を通してくる。
findings.governingReading: The blow mercilessly transmits its shock through him
findings.explanation: The English replaces transmitted internal force with a piercing action.

findings.highlight: My fists are dodged and parried
findings.evidenceJa: こちらの拳は躱され、弾かれ、引き込まれて
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s fists are dodged, deflected, and drawn in
findings.explanation: The third defensive manipulation, which sets up Kirei’s counters, disappears.

findings.highlight: my vision whites out.
findings.evidenceJa: 視界が真白に切り刻まれる。
findings.governingReading: His field of vision is sliced to white
findings.explanation: The English removes the blade-like violence linking the visual failure to Shirou’s sword-body.

findings.highlight: my vision will be cut off soon.
findings.evidenceJa: 視覚も、じき死に絶える。
findings.governingReading: His sight too will soon die out
findings.explanation: The English changes organic sensory death into an external cutoff.

findings.highlight: His bloody fists pulverize my body.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の全身をくまなく粉砕している。
findings.governingReading: The bloody fists pulverize every part of his whole body
findings.explanation: The English drops the exhaustive bodily extent.

findings.highlight: I don’t know which one of us will die first.
findings.evidenceJa: 終わるのは、どちらが早いのか、もう、
findings.governingReading: Which will end first—his body or his brain—the thought itself breaks off
findings.explanation: The English completes damaged cognition and invents a contest over which fighter dies first.

findings.highlight: A jolt runs through my left rib.
findings.evidenceJa: 左わき腹に衝撃
findings.governingReading: An impact strikes his left flank
findings.explanation: The English changes a bodily region into a single rib.

findings.highlight: the swords stabbing my brain
findings.evidenceJa: 脳を切りきざむ刃
findings.governingReading: Blades slicing his brain to pieces
findings.explanation: The English weakens repeated cutting into stabbing.

findings.highlight: my body’s about to cry out from it.
findings.evidenceJa: 体中が、痛みで泣きそうになっている。
findings.governingReading: His entire body feels ready to weep from pain
findings.explanation: The English conventionalizes a whole-body personification into vocal reaction.

findings.highlight: Flung like a rag doll, my body hits a large piece of rubble
findings.evidenceJa: 落盤した岩にぶつかって
findings.governingReading: His flung body strikes a rock from the cave-in
findings.explanation: The English adds a rag-doll simile and generalizes cave-in debris.

findings.highlight: the pain to reinforce my body
findings.evidenceJa: 体を作り変えようとする脳への痛み
findings.governingReading: Pain in the brain from trying to remake the body
findings.explanation: The English substitutes Strengthening for involuntary bodily reconstruction.

findings.highlight: I’ll burn out, unable to bear the pain.
findings.evidenceJa: あと一秒で痛みに耐え切れず焼き切れ、何も考えられなくなる。
findings.governingReading: In one more second he will burn out from the pain and become unable to think
findings.explanation: The English omits the exact one-second limit and loss of thought.

findings.highlight: Both of us might disappear within the next minute.
findings.evidenceJa: 一分後に消えてもおかしくない。
findings.governingReading: It would be unsurprising if either vanished one minute from now
findings.explanation: The English changes the temporal point into an interval.

findings.highlight: That man has no goal! He’s just following his way of life he protected…!
findings.evidenceJa: あの男には目的なんてない、ヤツにとって当然のように守ってきた在り方だけだ
findings.governingReading: Kirei has no goal, only the way of being he has upheld as naturally self-evident
findings.explanation: The English produces malformed agency and obscures Kirei’s maintenance of a rule-like mode of being.

findings.highlight: Her body was dying
findings.evidenceJa: 未来のない体で
findings.governingReading: With a body that had no future
findings.explanation: The English turns Sakura’s terminal lack of future into an ongoing death process.

findings.highlight: my attack
findings.evidenceJa: 相打ち覚悟の拳
findings.governingReading: A punch thrown accepting a mutual hit
findings.explanation: The English removes Shirou’s willingness to trade blows in the final gamble.

findings.highlight: counterattacked me with a hard shot.
findings.evidenceJa: 強烈なのをぶち込まれた。
findings.governingReading: Kirei drives a devastating blow into him
findings.explanation: The English’s vague “hard shot” weakens the counter’s force and physical delivery.

findings.highlight: I’m blown away
findings.evidenceJa: 飛ばされ、蹲る俺
findings.governingReading: Shirou is sent flying and left crouched or doubled over
findings.explanation: The English drops his posture before Kirei approaches to crush his head.

findings.highlight: My enemy looms over me.
findings.evidenceJa: 立ちはだかり、覆い被さる敵の影。
findings.governingReading: The enemy’s shadow blocks his way and hangs over him
findings.explanation: The English retains looming but removes the blocking relation and shadow image.

findings.highlight: My legs don’t moveyeah, my right leg really doesn’t move at all
findings.evidenceJa: 言う事をきかない足ああ、右足はホントにピクリとも動かない
findings.governingReading: The disobedient leg—his right leg will truly not twitch at all
findings.explanation: The English begins by disabling both legs before returning to the singular right leg.

findings.highlight: I fire them up to raise my body.
findings.evidenceJa: に火をつけて体を起こす。
findings.governingReading: He sets the leg afire to raise his body
findings.explanation: The English turns literal self-destructive ignition into a motivational idiom.

findings.highlight: I won’t die here.
findings.evidenceJa: このままでは終わらない。
findings.governingReading: It will not end like this.
findings.explanation: The English resolves the broader refusal of this ending specifically into survival.

findings.highlight: The guy in front of me didn’t make it. He’s standing in front of me with an upraised fist.
findings.evidenceJa: 拳を俺の目前まで突き上げたまま、間に合わなかった姿を見た。
findings.governingReading: Shirou sees that the man failed in time, his fist still thrust up immediately before Shirou’s face
findings.explanation: The English separates the posture from the failure and removes the fist’s endpoint at Shirou’s face.

findings.highlight: So he became half-dead in the forest a bit before I did.
findings.evidenceJa: わずかに、この男の方が早かったのか。
findings.governingReading: Perhaps Kirei became a dying body in the forest just slightly before Shirou
findings.explanation: The English promotes Shirou’s question into fact and weakens a body already reduced to death’s threshold.

findings.highlight: you must hurry if you need to do something
findings.evidenceJa: 目的があるのなら急ぐがいい
findings.governingReading: If you have a purpose, hurry
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the purpose that distinguishes Shirou from Kirei into an unspecified task.

findings.highlight: Go to the Holy Grail and fulfill your wish.
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯を前にし、その責務を果たすがいい
findings.governingReading: Stand before the Grail and fulfill that responsibility
findings.explanation: The English replaces the last Master’s duty with personal wish fulfillment.

findings.highlight: He continues to be my despicable enemy.
findings.evidenceJa: 崩れていくこの瞬間さえ、いけすかない俺の敵であり続ける。
findings.governingReading: Even in this collapsing instant, Kirei remains Shirou’s detestable enemy
findings.explanation: The English drops the scene’s final temporal test of Kirei’s unchanging role.

findings.highlight: this is for hurting me so much
findings.evidenceJa: 散々いためつけてくれたお礼だ
findings.governingReading: This is repayment for thoroughly beating him up
findings.explanation: The English weakens Shirou’s sardonic description of their physical fight.

findings.highlight: On the verge of rusting away, my eyes
findings.evidenceJa: スクラップ寸前の俺の眼
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s eyes, nearly reduced to scrap
findings.explanation: The English adds rust and shifts the scrap-state from his eyes toward Shirou generally.

findings.highlight: The priest disappears from this world
findings.evidenceJa: 神父は今度こそ、この苦界から消えていった。
findings.governingReading: This time, at last, the priest disappears from this world of suffering
findings.explanation: The English removes both the finality after Kirei’s prior false death and the Buddhist-inflected world of suffering.
